name: White Oak Slat Wall Tiles, Black Felt
summary: White oak acoustic wood slat wall tiles with a black felt backing, sold as modular tiles in real natural oak.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet is published; the dimension diagram shows eight slats per 12.60-inch strip (sixteen per 25.2-inch panel), giving a 1.575-inch pitch, with photo-estimated 1.10-inch faces and 0.475-inch black felt gaps. This tile spans eight pitches by 25.2 inches; 0.83-inch total thickness comes from the supplied record, and oak tones are sampled from the main listing photo.
